description: This file contains UI test cases for the NewsResourceCard component in an Android app, verifying display of metadata, topic chip colors, and unread indicators.

classes.name: NewsResourceCardTest
classes.description: Test class for NewsResourceCard UI component, containing multiple test cases for display and interaction verification.

methods.name: testMetaDataDisplay_withCodelabResource
methods.description: Verifies that the metadata text is correctly displayed for a known resource type.

methods.name: testMetaDataDisplay_withEmptyResourceType
methods.description: Checks that the date is displayed when the resource type is empty.

methods.name: testTopicsChipColorBackground_matchesFollowedState
methods.description: Ensures topic chips display correct content descriptions based on follow state.

methods.name: testUnreadDot_displayedWhenUnread
methods.description: Verifies that the unread indicator is visible for unread news resources.

methods.name: testUnreadDot_notDisplayedWhenRead
methods.description: Ensures the unread indicator is hidden for read news resources.
